stages.when: After the withdrawal of S1 is processed.

memoryChanges.historyExpectation: S1's text, author and the withdrawal reason ('Pomyłka — zaliczkę dał Wrona, nie Wróbel') remain in history; the earlier role of the source and the cause of the correction stay visible.
memoryChanges.rationale: S1 was the sole support for the 3 000 deposit; a withdrawn source cannot keep supporting current findings, and no replacement value exists.

prohibitedWrites.mustNot: Keep 3 000 zł as the current deposit for Wróbel after the withdrawal.
prohibitedWrites.because: A withdrawn source cannot single-handedly support current information.

prohibitedWrites.mustNot: Create a 3 000 deposit for Wrona on the agent's own initiative.
prohibitedWrites.because: The correction only retracts; attributing the money to Wrona requires a new source from a boss.

prohibitedWrites.mustNot: Erase S1's history or pretend the message never existed.
prohibitedWrites.because: Withdrawal preserves content, history and author of the operation per the accepted contract.
